translations.answer: Confirm that the mesh has contype/conaffinity equal to 0, and that collisions are only specified via contact/pair. If so, use the MuJoCo version containing commit 3434f5d. This commit is parsed during compilation, marking the mesh as needing a convex hull and adding it to the ConvexHullForPairCollisionMeshes regression test. The original author did not report a retest after upgrade, but the maintenance team's diagnosis, the author's model confirmation, and the official source code fix and test form a complete evidence chain.
translations.applicability: Applies to MuJoCo/MJX 3.3.4 and versions lacking the commit, and meshes that only participate in collisions via contact/pair.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and consistent, and there is an exact reference to formal documentation or independent reproducibility.
translations.details.attempts.0: The maintainer aligned the issue with the original model's contact pair; the author confirmed the original model indeed had a pair.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Check that the mesh has contype/conaffinity both equal to 0, but only participates in collisions via contact/pair.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Check that the installed version includes commit 3434f5d or that the corresponding fix is listed in the changelog.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use a version of MuJoCo containing commit 3434f5d9c774bf56d3cf4dd26d0beca8d9c509f1; this fix compiles pairs before convex-hull checks and marks the mesh as needing a hull.
translations.details.environments.0: MuJoCo/MJX 3.3.4; Python API; Ubuntu 24.04; the original model uses contact/pair to specify meshes with contype=0, conaffinity=0 for collision participation.
translations.details.limits.0: The maintainer pointed out that the minimal reproduction reported by the original poster does not match the actual bug; this must be verified before applying the fix.
translations.details.limits.1: The fix cannot be applied to all cases of mesh.py convex errors.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The fix is added to a dedicated pair-collision mesh regression test and written to the changelog; the original author did not report a retest after upgrade.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How should MJX put_model handle meshes that participate in collisions only via contact pair?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: After upgrade, regression tests should be performed on the number of contact points, normal vectors, and friction behavior, and should not be evaluated solely on whether put_model does not throw an error.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The official submission states: meshes that only participate in collisions via contact pair are not marked for convex hull calculation.
translations.details.symptoms.0: mjx.put_model throws a mesh.py convex error; the mesh_graphadr is -1; the mesh does not throw an error when replaced with a box.
translations.source.locator: MuJoCo #2777 maintenance diagnosis 3133421618, author model confirmation 3134769229; commit 3434f5d
translations.source.title: MJX put_model encounters a convex hull error when handling meshes that only participate in collisions via contact pair
